items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: I stayed over here with a girl. Her name was Susie.

ctx.x: How smart I was. (Unintelligible) in the building. I said, "Thank God," and these people flew. And I said -- and when they got there, I say, "Take me as far as the seventh floor," and they took me as far as the seventh floor and let me off and they got off with me, I went into my room. Herschel was staying with me -- I got two rooms (unintelligibile) for Herschel and I stayed over here with a girl. Her name was Susie. (Unintelligible) and I rented a room for Herschel.
That was a hotel. Was that a hotel?
